title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings

suppliers.sup:70110: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) – our proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer and for the many years of reliable partnership. We value it and want a solution that works for your foundry.

Our should-cost estimate for part:310010 is EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010), below your price. The forecast for part:310010 increased by 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price. PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%.

We attach three packages. Following your request on faster payment, one of them shortens our payment terms to ease your cash flow. Which package suits you best, and what is your earliest possible lead time?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) – our proposal
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point.

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We welcome the 14-day payment term, and in return, we are prepared to accept the later effective date of 1 April 2027. Regarding your question, our earliest possible lead time for these volute casings remains our standard timeframe. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

Our updated offer is a price of €136.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer is valid for 30 days.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings – revised package
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for accepting the later effective date together with 14-day payment. We are keeping exactly that package: 14-day payment, which supports your cash flow, and the effective date of 1 April 2027. Only the price is adjusted, as shown in the attached term sheet.

Your latest scorecard records on-time delivery of 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3).

We want a stable, healthy partnership for the HN casings. The package covers 8150 pieces per year over 12 months. Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant is possible, for example a different casting finish or batch size, that would lower your cost while keeping our quality?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings – revised package
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As to the delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We have verified the delivery record data you cited; as a family foundry that prides itself on reliability, we take this seriously and have adjusted our offer.

We appreciate the volume commitment of 8150 pieces per year, and our technical team will address your question regarding alternative casting finishes. For our cherished relationship, we propose a revised price of €132.70 per unit, maintaining the 14-day payment term and the 1 April 2027 effective date. To be precise, our offer stands at a price of €132.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Foundry Engineer: We build strictly according to your drawing and do not propose any design changes.

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings – revised term sheet
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your revised offer and for looking into alternative casting finishes. We look forward to your technical team's proposal.

We are keeping the same package: 14-day payment, which supports your cash flow, and an effective date of 1 April 2027. Only the price is adjusted, as shown in the attached term sheet. The package covers 8150 pieces per year over 12 months.

Your previous scorecard records 626 ppm (sc:70110@2026Q2).

We value the partnership your family foundry has shown, including in 2022, and we want a healthy, stable supply for both sides. Could you confirm the attached terms?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings – revised term sheet
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Our long-standing partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH means a great deal to our family foundry, and we have made significant concessions to support our partnership, and our price must now remain at €132.70. We have already taken that quality record data into account. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. For our offer, we state a price of €132.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. We are ready to confirm the contract for 8150 pieces per year with 14-day payment and an effective date of 1 April 2027 at this price. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) - revised term sheet
messages.body:
Dear Mr Thoma,

Thank you for confirming your offer and for the partnership your family foundry has shown over many years, including in 2022.

Our quality notifications qn:20004728, qn:20004837, qn:20004853, qn:20004877, qn:20004934, qn:20004978, qn:20004995 record defective deliveries of part:310010.

We are keeping exactly your package: 14-day payment to support your cash flow and an effective date of 1 April 2027, covering 8150 pieces per year over 12 months. We have moved our price towards yours in the attached term sheet.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) - revised term sheet
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have reviewed the quality notifications you listed; however, we already factored our quality record into our previous concessions. Having carefully considered everything, we have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal, just as our margin and our limits stay internal. We have reached the absolute limit of what our family foundry can offer for this package while maintaining our high standards. 

For our Angebot, we require a price of €132.70 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

We value our long relationship with your house and look forward to continuing our partnership on this solid foundation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body: Thank you - we are very close. We can sign today on your own terms at the price in the attached term sheet.

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your willingness to conclude this agreement today. For our long-standing partnership, we have carefully reviewed every detail once again. Our offer stands at a price of €132.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. 

As we have stated, €132.70 is the absolute limit for our family foundry under these terms. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our proposal remains valid for 7 days. This is our final offer, and we look forward to your confirmation to secure the supply of these volute casings.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
